candidates.name: Pemphigus vulgaris
support_spans: Revealed epidermal erosion with suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis
Direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis
Against desmoglein 1: 40 IU/mL (normal value: 20 U/mL)
Against desmoglein 3: 90 IU/mL (normal value: 20 U/mL)
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and histopathology results are consistent with pemphigus vulgaris, an autoimmune disease characterized by blistering of the skin and mucous membranes.

candidates.name: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
support_spans: A man in his 50s with a 10-year history of Crohn disease
Painful, erosive lesion present around the stoma on the anterior abdominal wall
candidates.why: The patient's history of Crohn disease and the development of a painful, erosive lesion around the stoma site may suggest a paraneoplastic pemphigus, a rare autoimmune disorder associated with underlying neoplasia.
